about: The collect of the First Sunday of Advent. It asks God to stir up His power and come, so that we may be snatched from the dangers our sins bring near and saved by His deliverance. The Glória is omitted in the Sunday Masses of Advent.

seg.tr: Stir up Your power, Lord, we pray, and come, so that, as You protect us, we may be found worthy to be rescued from the dangers that threaten us because of our sins and, as You set us free, to be saved. Who live and reign with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

ex.w010: The dangers are not remote: they already threaten the faithful.

nt.w032: “Deus” has the same form in the nominative and vocative. It can be read as “You who live and reign as God” or as a direct address, “O God.” In either case, the prayer’s conclusion refers to Christ.
